name: Museum Volunteers and Student Internships
what_you_do: Help with museum classes and outreach. Or work in restoration, the library, graphics or exhibits. If you need school credit, you can intern in the library, graphics or restoration.
who_can_apply: You must be 16 for most roles. The Education team takes ages 14 and up. Docent and Collections Care roles need age 18. Internships are only for students who need school credit.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Internships may earn school credit, based on your school's rules.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The museum takes volunteer forms on its page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Minor Volunteer form online. Want an internship? Do the form, then ask your school to contact the museum for you.
notes: Most roles are on weekdays, so check your school schedule. The Education team strongly prefers people with teaching or aviation training and a background check. Many other roles want shop or design skills. Museum phone: 619-234-8291.
